# AWS Account

Read-only account metadata, primary contact details, and region opt-in statuses for the calling account.

**Status: implemented subset.** Operation selection does not imply complete input or behavior parity.

| Contract | Current implementation |
| --- | --- |
| Service ID | `account` |
| Signing name | `account` |
| Wire protocol | REST JSON |
| API version | `2021-02-01` |
| Scope | Account-wide |
| Execution | Records |
| Selected operations | 4 of 18 in the pinned model |

## Implemented behavior

See the [implemented feature catalogue](catalogue.md#aws-account) for this service's capabilities.

## Limitations and future work

- Selected 28 commercial regions subset (17 standard, 11 opt-in) rather than full commercial AWS global region catalogue or GovCloud/China partitions.
- Read-only/records-only first slice: mutation operations like EnableRegion, DisableRegion, PutContactInformation, and AlternateContact APIs are not implemented.
- Organizations delegation and cross-account access are not supported; requests with another explicit AccountId are rejected with AccessDeniedException.
- Account has no ordinary resource lifecycle or mutation UI; no CloudFormation resource types are registered.

These gaps describe current boundaries and possible follow-up slices. The [roadmap](../roadmap/index.md)
separates proposed work from registered functionality; there are no promised release dates.

[shape whitelist](https://github.com/amjadjibon/tinystack/blob/main/generator/model/profile.json); an enabled operation may reject unsupported options.
